SELECT
  r."itemId" AS "parentItemId",
  h."parentRevisionId" AS "parentRevisionId",
  l."id" AS "lineId",
  l."lineNo" AS "lineNo",
  occ."id" AS "occurrenceId",
  occ."childItemId" AS "childItemId",
  occ."qty" AS "qty",
  occ."effectiveFrom" AS "effectiveFrom",
  occ."effectiveTo" AS "effectiveTo",
  occ."unitFrom" AS "unitFrom",
  occ."unitTo" AS "unitTo",
  occ."lotCodes" AS "lotCodes",
  occ."selectionConditionId" AS "selectionConditionId",
  h."id" AS "headerId",
  h."alternativeNo" AS "alternativeNo"
FROM "bom"."bom_line_occurrence" occ
JOIN "bom"."bom_line" l ON l."id" = occ."lineId"
JOIN "bom"."bom_header" h ON h."id" = l."headerId"
JOIN "bom"."item_revision" r ON r."id" = h."parentRevisionId"
WHERE h."state" = 'released'
  AND h."bomType" = $1
  AND h."orgId" = $2
  AND occ."childItemId" IN ($3)
  AND occ."effectiveFrom" <= $4
  AND (occ."effectiveTo" IS NULL OR occ."effectiveTo" > $5 OR (occ."ecnOutId" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bom"."ecn" e WHERE e."id" = occ."ecnOutId" AND e."state" = 'released')))
  AND (occ."ecnInId" IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bom"."ecn" e WHERE e."id" = occ."ecnInId" AND e."state" = 'released'))
ORDER BY l."lineNo" ASC, occ."effectiveFrom" ASC, occ."id" ASC

SELECT
  r."itemId" AS "parentItemId",
  h."parentRevisionId" AS "parentRevisionId",
  l."id" AS "lineId",
  l."lineNo" AS "lineNo",
  occ."id" AS "occurrenceId",
  occ."childItemId" AS "childItemId",
  occ."qty" AS "qty",
  occ."effectiveFrom" AS "effectiveFrom",
  occ."effectiveTo" AS "effectiveTo",
  occ."unitFrom" AS "unitFrom",
  occ."unitTo" AS "unitTo",
  occ."lotCodes" AS "lotCodes",
  occ."selectionConditionId" AS "selectionConditionId",
  h."id" AS "headerId",
  h."alternativeNo" AS "alternativeNo"
FROM "bom"."bom_line_occurrence" occ
JOIN "bom"."bom_line" l ON l."id" = occ."lineId"
JOIN "bom"."bom_header" h ON h."id" = l."headerId"
JOIN "bom"."item_revision" r ON r."id" = h."parentRevisionId"
WHERE h."state" = 'released'
  AND h."bomType" = $1
  AND h."orgId" = $2
  AND occ."childItemId" IN ($3)
  AND occ."effectiveFrom" <= $4
  AND (occ."effectiveTo" IS NULL OR occ."effectiveTo" > $5 OR (occ."ecnOutId" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bom"."ecn" e WHERE e."id" = occ."ecnOutId" AND e."state" = 'released')))
  AND (occ."ecnInId" IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bom"."ecn" e WHERE e."id" = occ."ecnInId" AND e."state" = 'released'))
ORDER BY l."lineNo" ASC, occ."effectiveFrom" ASC, occ."id" ASC
